title: TeleSnails
tagline: Make cross chain arbitrary contract calls and funds management through a web interface
description: TeleSnails App allows for easy and quick cross chain arbitrary contract calls through a web interface. After connecting your account you can deploy interchain accounts on the most popular chains, and using a simple domain specific language you can both make contract calls and hold/transfer funds, everything using a single transaction each time.
how_its_made: Using DALL-E and Figma we created a clean and cool interface based on the NounsDAO UI. To be able to deploy the interchain accounts and make the calls we implemented Hyperlane v3 (that has been just released, so we had to rapidly learn the new way this technology works), which enables us to work with most of the chains that have partnered with ETHIstanbul.
